title: GameViewFields
responsibility: Select and edit a game view title, dimension and visual direction with a read-only historical mode.

inputs.name: GameViewFields.view
inputs.description: Active game view containing scene direction and executable checkpoints.

inputs.name: GameViewFields.views
inputs.description: Available game views displayed by the view selector.

inputs.name: GameViewFields.readonly
inputs.description: Disable editing and generation for historical or otherwise immutable views.

inputs.name: GameViewFields.select
inputs.description: Callback selecting the requested view or checkpoint identity without saving the document.

inputs.name: GameViewFields.create
inputs.description: Callback creating an additional game view in the current document.

inputs.name: GameViewFields.change
inputs.description: Callback publishing the edited checkpoint, view patch or graph node list to its owner.

outputs.name: GameViewFields
outputs.description: Select and edit a game view title, dimension and visual direction with a read-only historical mode. Renders reactive UI and publishes edits through its callbacks.
